Training Topic / Competency Item: Information on the employer's surge plan as it pertains to the duties that employees will perform. As applicable, this training shall cover the plan for surge receiving and treatment of patients, patient isolation procedures, surge procedures for handling of specimens, including specimens from persons who may have been contaminated as the result of a release of a biological agent, how to access supplies needed for the response including personal protective equipment and respirators, decontamination facilities and procedures, and how to coordinate with emergency response personnel from other agencies
Purpose: Ensures all employees with occupational exposure participate in the aerosol transmissible diseases training program
Approval Basis: Employer provides the ATD training program under 5199(i), conducted by and with interactive access to a person knowledgeable in the subject matter and in the employer's exposure control or biosafety plan; no external approval.
Frequency: At the time of initial assignment to tasks where occupational exposure may take place; at least annually thereafter, not to exceed 12 months from the previous training
